item.title: Import AI #412: GPT-5 released; robots fold laundry; state space scaling laws
item.description: This week: OpenAI ships GPT-5 with significantly improved reasoning. Figure AI demonstrates multi-step laundry folding. A new paper on state space scaling laws suggests we're nowhere near saturating Mamba-style architectures.

item.title: Import AI #411: Sparse MoE breakthroughs; agent safety evals; chip shortage update
item.description: DeepMind publishes new results on sparse mixture-of-experts scaling. Anthropic releases updated agent safety evaluation benchmarks.
